title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park on 1969-07-11
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park
source: SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985 Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > C > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a soaring ’69 show, highlighted by a tear‑jerking Death Don't Have No Mercy and crystal‑clear mix.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as superbly clear and detailed, letting listeners hear every nuance on stage—from the crazy drum work in the jams to the emotional weight of “Death Don't Have No Mercy.” The performance itself is described as one of the best ’69 shows, with high energy throughout, though the track “Lovelight” is unfortunately cut.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give 5‑star ratings, emphasizing both an outstanding performance and exceptional soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note the amazing clarity, ability to hear everything happening on stage, and overall superb mix; only minor complaint is that “Lovelight” is missing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows a seamless flow with powerful jams and emotional ballads, keeping listeners smiling from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are described as 'crazy' during the jam, indicating a particularly energetic and standout performance.
